recent_excerpts: Spring Ring vishing hit 150+ employees across 10 firms via Microsoft Teams, pushing RMM tools and NTLM relay attacks against domain controllers.
Adaptive Security finds 3 seconds of audio enough to clone a voice for fraud; deepfake calls tricked employees into wiring $243K in one case. No detection tool caught the attack.
Two cybercrime groups — Cordial Spider and Snarky Spider — are conducting rapid SaaS extortion attacks using vishing and SSO abuse to steal data within hours, researchers warn.
